Load penetration test on RS soil; apparatus: LPT fixture; loading: static penetration. Recorded: load vs penetration.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 36 of the 57 points, and the rest were settled against the scan. Student reviewers have looked at 29 of the 57 points on the scan; two reviewers confirmed 28 of them (see the provenance page). The report labels the soil state differently in two places (Dense; Intermediate). The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, unit weight, bin or mold, fill depth are not reported.
:::

## Data

![load against penetration, SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-lpt-027.png){.lightbox}

Peak load 5035 N at 203.06 mm penetration; 5035 N at 203.62 mm, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-lpt-027/observations.csv) (57 points: 0 plotted symbols, 34 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: load in N against penetration in m; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-lpt-027/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 407 micrometers in penetration, 16.29 N in load (0.3 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 36 of the 57 points; the other 21 were settled against the scan (read by one reader and verified by the other, or decided between two readings). [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-f2-29).
